title: Changing a line to another inactive part is refused
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 15 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [Admin] = you, signed in with the Admin role, which by default has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Location: [Loc-1] = the location picked in the top-bar location switcher at the start; every step runs at [Loc-1] unless it names another location.
  • Data: [Part-A] = tracked part on [Line-1] of [WO-1] (added while active), then set inactive. [Part-B] = tracked part, set inactive. [Part-C] = tracked part, active.
  • Names and numbers marked (e.g. …) are examples only. What must hold is the status (active or inactive), tracking, quantity and link described above.

Setup

  1. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL SWAP A), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SWAP-01), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  2. [Part-A] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SWAP-01); [Desc-A] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL SWAP A).
  3. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL SWAP B), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SWAP-02), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  4. [Part-B] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SWAP-02); [Desc-B] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL SWAP B).
  5. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL SWAP C), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SWAP-03), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  6. [Part-C] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SWAP-03); [Desc-C] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL SWAP C).
  7. Go to Work Orders, click "New Work Order"; in Customer click Add and create a customer (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST PL SWAP Customer"); in Asset click Add and create a unit (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SWAP-UNIT"); click Create.
  8. [WO-1] = the work order number shown at the top left (e.g. S2-1234).
  9. On [WO-1] click "New Line", type Title (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST PL SWAP line"), click "Save & Close". [Line-1] = that line. Click "Approve" on [Line-1].
  10. On [Line-1] open the line's ⋮ menu, click "Request part", type [Part-A] in Part Number, pick the row that shows "Inventory Qty", set Quantity to 1 and click "Save Part".
  11. Set [Part-A] inactive: on the Active tab search [Part-A], click its row, pick Part Status "Inactive", click Save, leave the note empty and click "Deactivate" in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation.
  12. Set [Part-B] inactive: on the Active tab search [Part-B], click its row, pick Part Status "Inactive", click Save, leave the note empty and click "Deactivate" in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation.
  13. Check the setup worked: [Line-1] holds [Part-A]; [Part-A] and [Part-B] are on the Inactive tab, [Part-C] on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Open [WO-1] and open the [Part-A] row on [Line-1].
  2. Replace the part number with [Part-B] typed in full and save.
  3. Open the row again, replace the part number with [Part-C] (pick it from the lookup) and save.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: The change is refused with "[Part-B] is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it." and the row still holds [Part-A].
  • Step 3: The change saves and the row now holds [Part-C].

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v26 (Ready for dev), S9-E2a, S9-R17, read 8 Oct 2026; design canvas none. Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-E2a: “Changing that line to a different part, or typing a different number on it, is new work and follows S9-R17.”
  • S9-R17: “The system refuses an inactive part on new work however it arrives: adding a part to a work order or estimate line, raising a part request or special order, adding a part sale line, and adding a purchase order line or changing its part or number. The refusal reads "{part number} is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it."”
